json_patch.value: Fix: [deploy-helpers] Treat absent and undefined binding fields as equal in strict config diffs. Target files: .changeset/strict-upload-absent-binding-fields.md, packages/deploy-helpers/src/deploy/helpers/config-diffs.ts, packages/deploy-helpers/tests/config-diffs.test.ts. `wrangler versions upload --strict` (and `wrangler deploy --strict`) aborted on an unchanged config when a Worker had an R2 bucket in the default jurisdiction. The API omits `jurisdiction` in that case, but `mapWorkerMetadataBindings()` still sets an ow... (Ref: https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/pull/16359)
